verdict.rationale: Several hands-on community reports describe users replacing Windows with Fedora Workstation on the same machine, which shows the core of the story works in practice. One notes it 'just worked out of the box' and another says it went with minimal hiccups. The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of the installer or of the replace-existing-OS flow, and one user said setup required a lot of searching and trial. Missing for 10: first-party installer docs covering wiping or replacing an existing OS, and documentation of the disk-partitioning steps.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can install the OS in place of my current OS on the same machine

citations.quote: Replaced Windows on a $480 Lenovo laptop with Fedora 39, and it became a full Python development workstation quickly.
